text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The final race of the Classic Triple
Crown—the
Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think I would get the chance to
run in it
when you removed it from my
timetable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
choice_data_list: 調整が間に合ってよかった

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That said, I must focus on working
toward my new
goal now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I won't fixate on the fact that it's a Triple
Crown
race nor will I consider it different
from any other
race. This time, I only
have one goal...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And that is to get good results, as
always. That is
all.
